**Prerequisite: Complete the [Manual SDK Setup for Windows](../../guides/manual_sdk_setup_windows.md) (Python 3.13, pip, pyarrow, R, RStudio, Rtools). Run the steps below in RStudio.**

#### Install pak, if it was not already installed before.

```{r eval=FALSE}

install.packages("pak")

```

#### Install dataconnect library from GitHub

```{r eval=FALSE}

try({remove.packages("dataconnect")}, silent=TRUE)

pak::pak("mdsol/dataconnect-library-r@v1.3.0", upgrade = FALSE)

```


***For usage, please refer this [guide](rLibrary_usage_without_miniforge.html).***
